verses.text: Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? The lovingkindness of God endureth continually.

segments.text: Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man?

endureth

verses.text: Thy tongue deviseth very wickedness, Like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

segments.text: Thy tongue deviseth very wickedness,
Like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

verses.text: Thou lovest evil more than good, And lying rather than to speak righteousness. [Selah

segments.text: Thou lovest evil more than good,

verses.text: Thou lovest all devouring words, O thou deceitful tongue.

segments.text: Thou lovest all devouring words,
O thou deceitful tongue.

verses.text: God will likewise destroy thee for ever; He will take thee up, and pluck thee out of thy tent, And root thee out of the land of the living. [Selah

verses.text: The righteous also shall see it, and fear, And shall laugh at him, saying,

verses.text: Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength, But trusted in the abundance of his riches, And strengthened himself in his wickedness.

verses.text: But as for me, I am like a green olive-tree in the house of God: I trust in the lovingkindness of God for ever and ever.

verses.text: I will give thee thanks for ever, because thou hast done it; And I will hope in thy name, for it is good, in the presence of thy saints.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician. Maschil of David; when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, and said unto him, David is come to the house of Ahimelech.
